parsed.post: Kept DEPTH 8: 1.0277 -> 1.0089. Sub-1.0 achieved on the D6/AR32 branch! The capacity gains from depth are massive. Next: testing a slightly higher learning rate (0.08) to see if we can squeeze out more performance, while keeping the stable D8/AR32 foundation.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 8 and increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to push performance on the AR32 branch.
